title: DeFoe/Quotes
summary:
"Five elite Organization Suits can't corner one punk kid?"
- DeFoe, to his Suits (A Seeker Is Born)

"This is taking too long!"
- DeFoe to Grier (The Casterwill Client)

"Is that it, Ms Moon? No more subterfuge?"
- DeFoe to Zhalia Moon (Divide and Conquer)

"Your time has come, Dante Vale!"
- DeFoe to Dante Vale (The Treasures of the Argonauts)

"You are mine, Dante Vale!"
- DeFoe to Dante Vale (The Treasures of the Argonauts)

"Shut up! I'm going to finish this, and I'm going to do it the old fashioned way."
- DeFoe to Grier (The Treasures of the Argonauts)

"You are my minion, you idiot!"
- DeFoe to Grier (The Treasures of the Argonauts)
